callouts.title: 傅里叶变换版本的lemma
callouts.body:
如果$f \in L^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$,其傅里叶变换:
$$\hat{f}(\xi) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^n}f(x)e^{-2\pi i x \cdot \xi } dx$$那么$$|\hat{f}(\xi)|\to 0 \text{ as } |\xi| \to \infty$$
因为[[可积函数的傅里叶变换是连续的]]，那么这个命题实际上就是证明$$f \in L^1(\mathbb{R}^n) \implies \hat{f} \in C_0(\mathbb{R}^n)$$

classification_result.english_title: Lemma in the Fourier Transform Version

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in L^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$, and its Fourier transform is defined by $$\hat{f}(\xi) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^n}f(x)e^{-2\pi i x \cdot \xi } \, dx,$$ then $$|\hat{f}(\xi)|\to 0 \text{ as } |\xi| \to \infty.$$ Since the Fourier transform of an integrable function is continuous, this is essentially the statement that $$f \in L^1(\mathbb{R}^n) \implies \hat{f} \in C_0(\mathbb{R}^n).$$
prerequisites: continuity of the Fourier transform of integrable functions

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f \in L^1(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and for any $a\in \mathbb{R}^n$ define $T_a(f):=f(x-a)$. Then $$\|T_{a+h}(f)-T_a(f)\|_{L^1} \to 0$$ as $\|h\| \to 0$.
key_techniques: approximation of $L^1$ functions by continuous compactly supported functions

callouts.title: 傅里叶系数版本
callouts.body:
$f \in L^1(\mathbb{T})$那么$|\hat{f}(n)|\to 0$具体来说:
$$\hat{f}(n) =
\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} f(x)e^{-inx} dx \to 0 \text{
as } |n| \to \infty$$

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in L^1(\mathbb{T})$, then $|\hat{f}(n)|\to 0$. More precisely, $$\hat{f}(n) = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} f(x)e^{-inx} \, dx \to 0 \text{ as } |n| \to \infty.$$

callouts.title: 一般意义下的傅里叶变换
callouts.body: 函数$f\in L^1(G)$的傅里叶变换$\mathcal{F}(f)$可以被定义为,对任意$\chi \in \hat{G}$，$$\mathcal{F}(f)(\chi):=\int_{G} \overline{\chi(g)} f(g) \,d\mu(g)$$

classification_result.english_title: Fourier Transform in the General Setting

callouts.title: Riemann-Lebesgue引理
callouts.body: 定义在$L^1(G)$上的傅里叶变换$\mathcal{F}$是一个$$L^1(G)\to C_0(\hat{G})$$的线性泛函。

if_problem.statement_en: The Fourier transform $\mathcal{F}$ defined on $L^1(G)$ is a linear map $$L^1(G) \to C_0(\hat{G}).$$

callouts.title: 命题2
callouts.body: 拓扑空间$X$与拓扑群$Y$同构，即存在一个同胚映射$h:Y \to X$。现在假设$f\in C_0(X\to \mathbb{C})$那么$g = f\circ h \in C_0(Y\to \mathbb{C})$.

if_problem.statement_en: Let $X$ be a topological space and $Y$ a topological group, and suppose they are isomorphic as topological spaces, that is, there exists a homeomorphism $h:Y \to X$. If $f\in C_0(X\to \mathbb{C})$, then $g = f\circ h \in C_0(Y\to \mathbb{C})$.
key_techniques: preservation of continuity under composition with a homeomorphism
preservation of vanishing at infinity under homeomorphism

callouts.title: 命题3：命题1在LCA群上的推广
callouts.body: $G$是一个LCA群$f \in L^1(G)$对任意$a\in G$定义$T_a(f):=f(a^{-1}x)$。那么对于任意$\varepsilon >0$存在单位元$1_G$的邻域$U_{\varepsilon}$使得所有$h \in U_{\varepsilon}$都有$$||T_{ah}(f)-T_a(f)||_{L^1(G)}<\varepsilon$$

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 3: Generalization of Proposition 1 to LCA Groups

if_problem.statement_en: Let $G$ be an LCA group and let $f \in L^1(G)$. For any $a\in G$, define $T_a(f):=f(a^{-1}x)$. Then for every $\varepsilon >0$ there exists a neighborhood $U_{\varepsilon}$ of the identity element $1_G$ such that for all $h \in U_{\varepsilon}$, $$\|T_{ah}(f)-T_a(f)\|_{L^1(G)}<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: translation continuity in $L^1$ on LCA groups

callouts.title: 引理1
callouts.body: 对于LCA群$G$当中单位元$1_G$的任意邻域$U$存在$K \subseteq \hat{G}$使得如果$\chi \in \hat{G} - K$那么存在$x \in U$使得$\text{Re}\chi(x)\leq 0$.

if_problem.statement_en: For any neighborhood $U$ of the identity element $1_G$ in an LCA group $G$, there exists a set $K \subseteq \hat{G}$ such that if $\chi \in \hat{G} \setminus K$, then there exists $x \in U$ with $$\operatorname{Re}\chi(x)\leq 0.$$
key_techniques: properties of characters on LCA groups
compactness arguments in the dual group
